x: Moses Semakula has been taking the U13B sprints by storm.

Moses Semakula took the Thameside League Boys' best performance 1994, as well as gaining three Grade I standards as an U13. In the last year's cross country season Wesley Swaffer took the individual title in Surrey League with Bobby Peacock runner up, and Nigel Whorlow was runner up in the U13 group.

We filled out more of the events and the under 13 team was boosted by the first appearance of sprinter Moses Semakula - a great prospect. With Marlon Dickson, James Hilston, Geoffrey Ojok, Es Hassan and the Pauls Fox and Hills all winning their sprints, it was not surprising that we also did well in the relays.

He had slashed whole seconds off his best for the one lap race in one go but just to prove that it was no fluke he ran to 54.4 in the relay. Nicky also teamed up with another talented sprinter, Moses Semakula, to give us maximum points in the shot.
Shot (3.25kg) · 9.77 · Moses Semakula · 1st, Thameside League, Battersea Pk. · 2 Jul 1994
